description: 复杂残局，白方每步逼着黑方被动
explanation_en: White's king takes an active position and uses waiting moves to keep Black under pressure. Black's pieces are repeatedly forced to move, allowing White to win a key pawn and maintain the advantage.

intro.popup: 💡 逼着：局面极为复杂，白方几乎每步都在逼着黑方处于被动。Ke6是关键第一步！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Zugzwang: The position is complex, and White keeps forcing Black into passive moves. Ke6 is the key first step.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：白方通过Ke6进入要冲，Bd1控制黑象，再Kxd6吃兵取得决定性优势，全程逼着黑方应对。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Ke6 takes an active position; Bd1 restrains the bishop; then Kxd6 wins a pawn. White keeps forcing Black to respond throughout.

moves.popup: 白王Ke6，进入要冲！威胁Kxd6吃黑兵，同时向f7兵施压。
moves.popup_en: The white king moves to e6, threatening to capture on d6 and pressuring the pawn on f7.

moves.popup: 黑兵a5，黑方被迫寻找反攻——没有好的防守手段。
moves.popup_en: Black advances the a-pawn to seek counterplay, with no good defensive move available.

moves.popup: 白象Bd1！等招，盯住黑象，逼着黑象走棋暴露弱点。
moves.popup_en: White plays Bd1 as a waiting move, restraining the black bishop and forcing it to reveal a weakness.

moves.popup: 黑象Bh4，被迫走棋，离开了原来的位置。
moves.popup_en: The black bishop is forced to move to h4 and leave its original post.

moves.popup: 白王吃d6！逼着奏效，白方获得关键兵的优势。
moves.popup_en: White's king captures on d6. The zugzwang has worked, and White wins a key pawn.
The black bishop moves to f2, trying to pin White's pieces.

moves.popup: 白王Ke6，继续保持压力，威胁f7兵。
moves.popup_en: The white king returns to e6, maintaining pressure and threatening the pawn on f7.
The black bishop retreats to h4 under pressure.

moves.popup: d6！白兵前进，逼着黑方疲于应付多个威胁。
moves.popup_en: The pawn advances to d6, forcing Black to deal with multiple threats.
The black bishop moves to g3, continuing its attempt to block the advance.

moves.popup: 白王Kd5，进一步控制局面，后续推c兵或d兵升变。
moves.popup_en: The white king moves to d5 and tightens its control. White can continue with the c- or d-pawn toward promotion.
